title: 第17章 草根的觉悟 低调积蓄力量第18章 一群热心少年
content_zh:
“数千武君，那么多？”听得古风的话，万殿主觉得初来乍到就一下子见到这么多武君也是增长见识了。
“在天元大陆简直不可想象！”石殿主也很感叹，令得郑杰都有些不好意思，主要是自己连武君都不是而脸红。
“神君做为神界武者的第一个境界，若是在剑门恐怕多不胜数！”景儿猜想即将要进入的剑门，不知又是一种什么景象。
“也难怪人家看不起我们，每个世界都是一样，要想赢得尊重，就得提高自身修为，只有修为上去了，才有相应的话语权！”云剑尊是一群人中辈份最高的，是郑风的师祖，不忘提醒众人。
“风儿初入神界，修为上是没有神界有家族背景，有宗门势力优厚条件的少年那么惊艳，但我相信哪怕是作为神界的草根，不久的将来也会让神界为之色变。”灵嫣然作为郑风的师傅，可是从郑风最微末的时候，一路见证郑风从一个小小的炼体到武尊的强势崛起，对郑风成长的速度和修炼天赋她最有发言权。
“师傅我们天团少年现在对神界的修士来说就如同草根，还是无比稚嫩脆弱的草根。尽管如此我们也要倔强疯狂的生长。”郑风看着对自己无比信任的嫣然师傅，很是亲切，很是温暖。有了师傅的信任，感觉自己的信心又增强了很多。
“风儿，师祖要提醒你们，到了神界我们没有背景可以依靠，作为草根应有草根的觉悟，不要只看到草根的倔强和疯狂，即便刀劈火烧，来年又野蛮生长，欣欣向荣，一片繁茂！很多人没有看到受到摧残，受到践踏的草根，无声无息地将根深深的扎入泥土，不仅是向下，还向四周扩张。”
“这一切都是默默无闻的进行，没有自卑，没有炫耀，当他们冒出地面，根系已深植土壤，无论纵向还是横向。弱小的时候学会草根的低调，修为有成，也要注意一山还有一山高！”云剑尊很是平静犹如闲话家常，和一众少年分享人生智慧。
“师祖，风儿明白了，我们天团少年就先做低调而倔强的草根，默默地积蓄力量！”郑风面对云剑尊躬身一礼，语气诚恳，眼神自信，云剑尊很是欣慰。
天团少年看着郑风自信的神情，默默记下了“低调而倔强、默默积聚力量”的关键词。
“虽然我们现在修为低下，无法高调，我们就低调努力，一步步变强，待他日定要与参天大树试比高！”郑风语气铿锵，掷地有声。
一众少年心潮澎湃，意气风发，这是憧憬和展望，然而他们坚信跟着郑风一切皆有可能！
古风和万殿主等人，现在明白了，为什么天元大陆视郑风为全民偶像，跟着郑风的人，都会被他影响，性格倔强，积极向上。总是那么自信，心有阳光。
“说得好！真有激情！”众人听到一个陌生的声音大声叫好，众人你看我，我看你，都确认不是自己喊的。
“不用找了，把人家晾了这么久，也该打个招呼了！”塔灵看着郑风的自信言语令天团少年成员个个如打了鸡血，热血沸腾，自己也跟着有些激动起来，本想也调侃一下郑风，却发现被人先吼了一嗓子。
郑风看到躺在长椅上的少年正眯着眼睛，一脸的兴奋，手握拳头，嘴巴都还没有闭上。
“低调而倔强的草根默默地积蓄力量！”
“要与参天大树试比高！”
后面两句少年似反省时的咕哝，似思考时的呢喃。
“嗨，兄弟，是不是早就醒了？”郑风走到被救少年的长椅前，少年缓缓起身，有些脸红。

“你们这行人很有意思，虽然修为低下却有情有义，听你们口口声声喊天团少年，是不是有一个组织或团队叫天团？还需要人不？郑风你看看我可以加入不？虽然我现在暂时没有神晶。”少年一起来，仿佛自来熟，就叨叨叨地说起来。
“我们这个团队就叫天团少年，加入无需神晶，但你什么都不介绍，我真不知道你适不适合加入我们。”郑风觉得少年有趣，被人谋害了，还十分兴奋，莫非自己就有这么大的感染力？
“我叫康昊，是康庄的少庄主，我爹叫康豪，康庄的庄主，也就是一个小庄主，也没什么好介绍的，辛苦很多年还是被她老婆鄙视的一个小武王，我肯定比他强，十六岁武君八段。”康昊很随意的介绍着自己，脸上微笑着，眼神中却有淡淡的忧伤，虽然刻意隐藏，还是被郑风捕捉到了。
“你怎么没有介绍你娘？你妹或是其他家人？”郑杰看着康昊满是好奇，小孩子没有禁忌。
“我娘在我六岁那年就仙逝了。”康昊眼神中的忧伤更明显了。
“啊！”郑杰很是惊讶，随后觉得很不好意思。
“康昊你暂时不能回去，若有别的去处，建议你最好不要回去。除非你有足够的实力。”郑风听得康昊的简单几句和他的神情，结合最早巡逻队员讲述的联系起来。
明显是康昊的父亲康豪有一个厉害的大老婆，因娘家势大，没将康豪放在眼里，一心想让自己的儿子做未来的庄主，就算计了二老婆生的这个康家少庄主康昊。至于十年前康昊母亲的死因和康庄大夫人有没有关系不好说。
由于涉及到康昊提及的康庄庄主小武王康豪都招惹不起的恶婆娘，自己还是敬而远之。郑风想起之前的几波巡逻队，那是康庄大夫人不知道郑风一行救下了康昊，不然他们这行人，无一能逃脱。
郑风庆幸自己绕行康庄的决定，还有景儿为康昊的乔装。郑风没想到的是这些都不重要，重要的是康庄大夫人对自己的自信，认为自己做得天衣无缝，才高枕无忧。
康庄大夫人是知道康昊被丢到乱葬岗，她自认一早康昊就在乱葬岗被野兽分食了，她更是为了稳妥起见，翌日下午才下令搜查整个康庄，巡逻队全庄搜查，不过是给康豪的族人装装样子，她自认算无遗漏，才有郑风他们的侥幸逃脱。
content_en:
"Thousands of Martial Lords, so many?" After hearing Gu Feng's words, Palace Master Wan felt that seeing so many Martial Lords all at once would be a great gain for him when he first arrived.
"It's simply unimaginable in Tianyuan Continent!" Palace Master Shi also sighed, which made Zheng Jie a little embarrassed, mainly because he was not even a Martial Lord and blushed.
"The first realm of the Divine Lord as a warrior in the divine world, if it were in the Sword Gate, there would be countless of them!" Jing'er guessed what the scene would be like in the Sword Gate that he was about to enter.
"It's no wonder people look down on us. It's the same in every world. If you want to win respect, you have to improve your cultivation level. Only when your cultivation level goes up can you have the corresponding right to speak!" Yun Jianzun is the highest-ranking person in the group and Zheng Feng's master. He never forgets to remind everyone.
"When Feng'er first entered the God Realm, his cultivation is not as impressive as that of a young man with a family background and sect power in the God Realm. However, I believe that even as a grassroots in the God Realm, the God Realm will be changed in the near future." Ling Yanran is Zheng Feng's master, but she has witnessed Zheng Feng's strong rise from a small body training to a martial master from the time when he was at his lowest. She has the most say in Zheng Feng's growth speed and cultivation talent.
"Master, we young men from the Heavenly Group are now like grass roots to the monks in the God Realm. We are still extremely young and fragile grass roots. Despite this, we must be stubborn and grow crazily." Zheng Feng looked at Master Yan Ran, who had great trust in him, very kindly and warmly. With the trust of the master, I feel that my confidence has increased a lot.
"Feng'er, Master would like to remind you that we have no background to rely on when we reach the God Realm. As grassroots, we should have the awareness of grassroots. Don't just see the stubbornness and madness of grassroots. Even if they are cut by swords and burned by fire, they will grow wildly and flourish in the next year! Many people do not see the damaged and trampled grassroots. They silently sink their roots deep into the soil, not only downwards, but also in all directions."
"All of this is done in obscurity, without inferiority or showing off. When they emerge from the ground, their roots have been deeply embedded in the soil, both vertically and horizontally. When they were weak, they learned the low profile of grassroots, and when they are successful in cultivation, they must also pay attention to the height of each mountain!" Yun Jianzun was very calm, as if gossiping, sharing the wisdom of life with a group of young people.
"Master, Feng'er understands. We, the young men of Tiantuan, will be low-key and stubborn grassroots first, silently accumulating strength!" Zheng Feng bowed to Yun Jianzun with a sincere tone and confident eyes. Yun Jianzun was very pleased.
The boy from Tiantuan looked at Zheng Feng's confident expression and silently memorized the keywords of "low-key but stubborn, silently gathering strength".
"Although our cultivation level is low now and we cannot be high-profile, we will work hard in a low-key manner and become stronger step by step. One day we will definitely compete with the towering trees!" Zheng Feng said in a sonorous and resounding tone.
A group of young people are excited and high-spirited. This is their longing and expectation. However, they firmly believe that with Zheng Feng, anything is possible!
Gu Feng, Wan Dianzhu and others now understand why Tianyuan Continent regards Zheng Feng as the national idol. People who follow Zheng Feng will be influenced by him and have a stubborn and positive personality. Always so confident and sunny in heart.
"Well said! So passionate!" Everyone heard a strange voice cheering loudly. Everyone looked at me and I looked at you, and they all confirmed that it was not their own shouting.
"No need to look for it. It's time to say hello after waiting for so long!" Ta Ling saw that Zheng Feng's confident words made all the young members of Tiantuan feel excited. He also became a little excited. He wanted to tease Zheng Feng, but found that he was yelled at first.
Zheng Feng saw the young man lying on the bench squinting his eyes, looking excited, clenching his fists, and not closing his mouth.
"The low-key and stubborn grassroots are quietly gathering strength!"
"I want to compete with the towering trees!"
The last two sentences are youngIt's like a murmur when introspecting, like a murmur when thinking.
"Hey, brother, have you woken up early?" Zheng Feng walked to the bench where the rescued boy stood. The boy stood up slowly, blushing a little.
"You guys are very interesting. Although your cultivation is low, you are affectionate and righteous. I heard you keep calling Tiantuan boy. Is there an organization or team called Tiantuan? Do you still need people? Zheng Feng, can you see if I can join? Although I don't have a divine crystal for the time being." The young man came together and started chattering as if he was familiar with it.
"Our team is called Tiantuan Youth. You don't need a divine crystal to join, but you don't introduce me to anything. I really don't know if you are suitable to join us." Zheng Feng thought that the young man was interesting. He was murdered and was very excited. Could it be that he has such great appeal?
"My name is Kang Hao, and I am the young master of Kangzhuang. My father's name is Kang Hao. The master of Kangzhuang is also a young master. There is nothing to introduce. After working hard for many years, he is still a little martial king despised by his wife. I am definitely better than him. I am a sixteen-year-old martial master of the eighth degree." Kang Hao introduced himself casually, with a smile on his face, but there was a touch of sadness in his eyes. Although he deliberately concealed it, Zheng Feng still caught it.
"Why didn't you introduce your mother? Your sister or other family members?" Zheng Jie looked at Kang Hao with curiosity. Children have no taboos.
"My mother passed away when I was six years old." The sadness in Kang Hao's eyes became more obvious.
"Ah!" Zheng Jie was very surprised, and then felt very embarrassed.
"Kang Hao, you can't go back for the time being. If you have somewhere else to go, I suggest you not to go back. Unless you have enough strength." Zheng Feng heard Kang Hao's simple words and his expression, combined with what the earliest patrol members told.
Apparently, Kang Hao's father, Kang Hao, had a powerful eldest wife. Because his natal family was powerful, he did not take Kang Hao seriously. He wanted his son to be the future owner of the village, so he took advantage of Kang Hao, the young owner of the Kang family, who was born to his second wife. As for whether the death of Kang Hao's mother ten years ago had anything to do with Mrs. Kang Zhuang, it's hard to say.
Since it involves the evil woman that Kang Hao, the owner of Kangzhuang, Xiaowu Wang Kanghao cannot afford to offend, he still keeps away from her. Zheng Feng thought of the previous waves of patrols. Mrs. Kang Zhuang didn't know that Zheng Feng and his party had rescued Kang Hao, otherwise none of them would have been able to escape.
Zheng Feng was grateful for his decision to bypass Kangzhuang and Jing'er's disguise for Kang Hao. What Zheng Feng didn't expect was that none of these were important. What was important was Mrs. Kangzhuang's confidence in herself. She believed that she had done a perfect job, so she could sit back and relax.
Mrs. Kangzhuang knew that Kang Hao had been thrown into a mass grave. She believed that Kang Hao had been eaten by wild beasts in the mass grave early in the morning. To be on the safe side, she ordered a search of the entire Kangzhuang the next afternoon. The patrol team searched the entire village, which was just to show off to Kang Hao's clan. She believed that everything was done, and Zheng Feng and the others were lucky enough to escape.
